name: FedRAMP (NIST SP 800-53 rev5 baselines)
notes: Infrastructure-relevant NIST 800-53 control families as applied by FedRAMP Moderate. Family-level summary with representative controls, not the full baseline (~320 controls). Deployment in a FedRAMP-authorized region/partition (e.g. AWS GovCloud, Azure Government) is a prerequisite question to raise. Not a 3PAO assessment.

requirements.name: Access Control (AC-2, AC-3, AC-6, AC-17)
requirements.description: Account management, access enforcement, least privilege, and remote access control.
infra_signals: session manager / bastion instead of open SSH
remote admin only over VPN or private endpoints

requirements.name: Audit and Accountability (AU-2, AU-6, AU-9, AU-11)
requirements.description: Audit event logging, review, protection of audit information, and retention.
infra_signals: logs shipped to a separate restricted account/project
retention meeting agency requirements (typically >= 90 days online, 1 year archive)

requirements.name: Configuration Management (CM-2, CM-3, CM-6, CM-8)
requirements.description: Baseline configurations, change control, configuration settings, and component inventory.
infra_signals: IaC as authoritative baseline in version control

requirements.name: Contingency Planning (CP-6, CP-7, CP-9, CP-10)
requirements.description: Alternate storage/processing sites, system backup, and recovery.
infra_signals: multi-AZ deployment; alternate region for Moderate+

requirements.name: Identification and Authentication (IA-2, IA-5)
requirements.description: Multifactor authentication and authenticator management for organizational users.
infra_signals: secrets in a managed vault with rotation

requirements.name: System and Communications Protection (SC-7, SC-8, SC-13, SC-28)
requirements.description: Boundary protection, transmission confidentiality, FIPS-validated cryptography, and protection of data at rest.
infra_signals: encryption at rest with KMS/CMK everywhere
no direct public access to internal components

requirements.name: System and Information Integrity (SI-2, SI-3, SI-4)
requirements.description: Flaw remediation, malicious code protection, and system monitoring.

requirements.name: Risk Assessment (RA-5)
infra_signals: continuous vulnerability scanning of instances, containers, and IaC
findings routed to a tracked queue

requirements.name: Incident Response (IR-4, IR-6)
infra_signals: alerting wired to an incident channel

requirements.name: System and Services Acquisition (SA-11, SA-22)
requirements.description: Developer security testing and unsupported component replacement.
infra_signals: no end-of-life runtimes or unsupported OS images in the stack
